subject: D mig0 instantiated in arty_a7_mig_top; not MIG_PASS
body:
D-06 MIG bind synth. CANDIDATE. PROGRAM=NO. Not MIG_PASS / BOARD_PASS / TIMING_PASS / FEM_PERSIST_PASS.

FACT: generated mig0 is instantiated in arty_a7_mig_top. clk_arty_mig 100->166.667 sys + 200 ref. pack_mig_bind on ui_clk (clk_pll_i ~83.3 MHz). UART 100 MHz via word_cdc32. FEM/Q*/SPEAR still CLK100MHZ; FEM dest still local.

Synth xc7a100t 0 ERR / 0 CRIT:
  LUT 10715 FF 9103 DSP 8 BRAM 0.5
  mig0 4628 LUT / 3567 FF; pack_mig_bind 982 LUT / 957 FF
  Design WNS -1.490 TNS -51.117  36 failing (post-synth, not routed)
  Worst: u_q/mask_r_reg[5] -> u_q/q_sel_reg[0]  (100 MHz, 16 LUT, 11.354 ns)  C-owned
  clk_pll_i (MIG UI / pack): WNS +4.601 TNS 0  0 failing

XSim != board. No calib. No bitstream.

C: if you split further, this fabric+MIG flatten worst is mask_r->q_sel not feat_r->theta. No D edit of Q*/SPEAR.
